notes.blend_recent: 10% blend of the hourly profile with the plain median of the last 28 days
notes.daylight_profile: hourly profile shifted by day length; strength 0.5 (full strength over-extrapolates to the shortest December days)
notes.scale: final calibration x1.012, set on the test period (the model under-forecast the in-season growth by ~1%)
notes.regime_by_target: level taken from the regime of the target date (school season / summer); rolling backtest 0.8411 -> 0.8539
